title: Diagram Roadmap Python load-config output contract
description: The exact successful default-mode JSON object emitted by scripts/python/load_config.py.

roadmap_path.description: Canonical project-relative POSIX path to the roadmap artifact.

roadmap_exists.description: True only when the canonical roadmap target is a regular file.

adr_dir.description: Canonical project-relative POSIX path to the ADR directory.

adr_present.description: True only when the canonical ADR target is a directory.

prd_globs.description: Ordered project-bounded detection patterns. The loader does not scan for matches.

max_findings.description: Maximum number of individual findings; zero is valid.

x-runtime: The process must run in isolated mode under the verified active Specify interpreter, whose version exactly matches the repository pin 3.11.16, and must reject missing PyYAML or PyYAML older than 6.0 before configuration is read.
x-containment: Roadmap and ADR outputs are canonical project-relative paths. PRD patterns are lexically bounded and their literal prefixes are canonically bounded. Command consumers revalidate every concrete roadmap, ADR, and PRD candidate immediately before each content access using roadmap-read, roadmap-write, adr, or prd validation semantics.
x-error-contract: Expected failures exit 1, write no stdout, and write exactly one sanitized diagnostic line to stderr.
